content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "This judge text resolves a pressed Isaiah 7:14 link by the sign verse's own omission of a mechanism, not by the pressing side's chain read together.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the sign itself does not state the mechanism.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "the phrase 'never verse by verse' / 'weighs chain against chain by footing': I weighed (1) the judge may fault the sign verse itself for not stating the mechanism, and (2) the judge must assess the competing chains' support and footing instead.", "why": "The judge labels the link UNDERDETERMINED because 'the sign itself does not state the mechanism,' which is the verse-by-verse stating-verse move K-C retires when a pressed chain is at issue."}
